paragraphs.text: Eitoku was a soratami bushi from Kamigawa , who was set on a task in Numai together with his shinobi partner by Chiyo .

When dealing with Marrow-Gnawer and his nezumi, they were interrupted by Toshi Umezawa . In the following fight, Eitoku was seriously wounded when his attempt to stab Toshi through the chest was reflected by Toshi's kanji back to him.

Eitoku was later seen in Otawara , alive and healed, arguing with Chiyo . His further fate is unknown, though it is possible that he perished during the oni's onslaught on Otawara or the Jukai campaign.
